name: Event Marker L3: Threshold Crossing (Numbers Only)
description: Tests L3 threshold crossing: RSI overbought event with numeric-only columns (no string badge). Hero + Subtitle card slots.
source:
src = study_assets()
close = src.c

rsi_14 = rsi(close, 14)
rsi_overbought = rsi_14 > 70

event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(title='RSI Overbought', icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon, schemas=[
    ColumnSpec(title='RSI Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
    ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
    ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
]))((rsi_14, close, rsi_overbought))

xy_lines(title='RSI 14', category='Analysis', series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
    LineSeriesSpec(name='RSI', color=Color.Orange)
]))(x_values=index(), y_values=rsi_14)
